decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a specialist, certification-heavy niche with long procurement cycles, so a 2023 product line is unlikely to be withdrawn after one year.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and fits the firm's ergonomic office lighting portfolio, though desk lamps are a more competitive, less core segment.
The general interior luminaire is a newly launched second generation (G2) with its own page and core to the firm's building lighting business.
The firm presents this microprismatic pendant as a flagship of its direction toward efficient, glare-free office lighting, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The HMI searchlight uses older discharge-lamp technology that conflicts with the firm's LED focus, but marine customers need long-term availability and spare-part continuity.
The marine searchlight line serves robust specialist customers with long lifecycle requirements and complements the firm's marine offering.
